title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin trades at $64,089, down 1.1 percent in the last 24 hours as fear grips the market with a 28 reading on the index. US morning session showed steady selling pressure without major catalysts.

On-chain, hashrate sits at 835.8 EH/s, confirming miner commitment. The mempool holds 88,368 transactions with the fastest fee at just 1 sat per vB, signaling light priority demand despite volume.

Block height reached 959,451 at the 18:00 UTC mark. No breaking news moving the tape.
